summary: Arrange a fictional planted space around a sequence of open and sheltered rooms with a clear central gathering point.
objective: Plant groups retain distinct silhouettes and the visitor route is not blocked by decorative leaves or furniture.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a botanical sanctuary
Use garden sanctuary as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Design a botanical sanctuary with readable paths, layered plant silhouettes and a small central greenhouse.

principles: Arrange a fictional planted space around a sequence of open and sheltered rooms with a clear central gathering point.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Group plants by contrasting silhouette and height; give walkways, planters and greenhouse framing a consistent scale.
Use foliage-like surfaces and selected ceramic or timber accents; control dappled-looking light so paths and labels stay readable.
Use alternating close plant and wider spatial views; restrained leaf motion can support atmosphere without implying a wind calculation.
observable_checks: Plant groups retain distinct silhouettes and the visitor route is not blocked by decorative leaves or furniture.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with hand-painted, translucent architectural accents or stylized realism; invented plants are not botanical identifications.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
